description: This file defines the ValidateResponseChecksumResultMutator class, which is a custom implementation of an S3 result mutator for validating response checksums in AWS SDK for PHP. It includes methods for checking checksum validation status and selecting appropriate checksum headers, integrating checksum validation into S3 response handling.

classes.name: ValidateResponseChecksumResultMutator
classes.description: A final class implementing S3ResultMutator that validates response checksums based on operation configuration and response headers.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the class with an Aws API Service object.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Main method invoked to perform checksum validation on a result, possibly throwing an exception if validation fails.

methods.name: validateChecksum
methods.description: Helper method to validate checksum by comparing header value with computed value from response body.

methods.name: chooseChecksumHeaderToValidate
methods.description: Selects the checksum header to validate based on provided priority and response headers.
